item.title: Ohio sends cease-and-desist notices to 10 prediction market companies with an October 16 deadline — Oct 15, 2026 · 9:45 AM ET
item.description: - **Ohio sends cease-and-desist notices to 10 prediction market companies with an October 16 deadline** — Ohio regulators sent cease-and-desist notices dated October 2 to 10 operators offering sports event contracts, including Polymarket, Novig, Underdog, Coinbase, ProphetX and Robinhood. The state gave recipients until October 16 to stop offering the contracts in Ohio or face civil penalties, and Kalshi was not among the companies that received a notice. ([Covers](https://www.covers.com/industry/ohio-regulator-sends-cease-and-desist-notices-to-10-prediction-market-companies-oct-5-2026))

item.title: Gemini, Webull and ProphetX halt Connecticut operations after state orders — Oct 15, 2026 · 9:45 AM ET
item.description: - **Gemini, Webull and ProphetX halt Connecticut operations after state orders** — Connecticut officials said Gemini, Webull and ProphetX have halted operations in the state after the Department of Consumer Protection sent orders to nine platforms in September to stop offering sports event contracts. The other six platforms named in the orders, including Polymarket, Coinbase, Crypto.com, Robinhood, Novig and Underdog, remain in communication with the department. ([15M News](https://15m.com/news/gemini-webull-and-prophetx-exit-connecticut-after-state-crackdown/))

item.title: RuleGuard tool flags prediction markets that look identical but settle under different rules — Oct 15, 2026 · 7:15 AM ET
item.description: - **RuleGuard tool flags prediction markets that look identical but settle under different rules** — A GitHub project called RuleGuard scanned 59,399 open markets across Kalshi, Polymarket, Limitless and Manifold and found 187 pairs that look identical. In a random cross-operator sample, rules fully matched in only 1 of 11 pairs, and among 341 settled Kalshi-Polymarket pairs since 2023, 7 paid out in opposite directions because of rule differences. ([GitHub](https://github.com/aldikbobr/ruleguard))

item.description: - **Oracle3 open-source trading engine for prediction markets passes 600 tests** — Oracle3, an open-source trading engine and MCP server on GitHub, maps relationships between event contracts across Kalshi, Polymarket and Solana venues and looks for fee-adjusted pricing violations. item.description: - **October Fed hike odds halved in two one-hour bursts on Kalshi and Polymarket, trade-tape analysis finds** — CleanSky reconstructed second-by-second trade data showing the Kalshi October hike contract fell from 67 to 46 cents in a single hour on September 29, with 310,742 contracts traded. item.description: - **S&P Global survey finds 70 percent of prediction market users traded sports contracts** — A third quarter 2026 S&P Global Market Intelligence Kagan survey found just 10 percent of respondents traded on a yes or no exchange in the past year, and among those users 70 percent traded sports contracts, ahead of financial outcomes at 36 percent and political outcomes at 33 percent. item.title: CFTC October 9 actions draw a line between event contracts and casino or sportsbook wagers — Oct 15, 2026 · 2:15 AM ET
item.description: - **CFTC October 9 actions draw a line between event contracts and casino or sportsbook wagers** — On October 9 the CFTC issued an interim final rule and a separate proposal that would treat sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts as swaps under federal derivatives oversight, while casino games and traditional sportsbook wagers stay outside that definition. Federal appeals courts remain divided over sports contract jurisdiction, with the NFL backing state oversight and Robinhood backing exclusive federal authority. ([Cryptonomist](https://en.cryptonomist.ch/2026/10/10/cftc-prediction-markets-regulation-2/))

item.description: - **Thirty days of esports data finds Polymarket in 13.2 percent of arbitrage cases and Kalshi in 2.8 percent** — A dev.to analysis of esports prices from September 6 to October 6 across 25 sportsbooks plus Polymarket and Kalshi found about 4.87 million arbitrage cases in total. item.title: ESMA report calls prediction markets rife with inside trading — Oct 14, 2026 · 10:45 PM ET
item.description: - **ESMA report calls prediction markets rife with inside trading** — A WeeBet report on a September 2026 ESMA assessment says the EU regulator flagged inside trading concerns on platforms including Kalshi and Polymarket and called for urgent scrutiny. It also noted inconsistent EU geo-blocks and that neither platform holds an EU financial services licence. ([WeeBet](https://weebet.com/news/esma-prediction-markets-inside-trading-kalshi-polymarket))

item.title: Pew Research tracks a sharp rise in Kalshi and Polymarket trading volume — Oct 14, 2026 · 10:45 PM ET
item.description: - **Pew Research tracks a sharp rise in Kalshi and Polymarket trading volume** — Pew Research Center reports sports, politics and cryptocurrency have made up about 91 percent of Kalshi volume and 90 percent of Polymarket volume since July 2024. It notes Polymarket US volume of 1.3 billion dollars in April 2026 compared with 9 billion dollars on Polymarket International.
